entries.name: Community Ticker
entries.description: A top-right price ticker with a live sparkline.
entries.preview:
# Community Ticker

Streams the latest price into a top-right overlay and
keeps a short sparkline of recent moves. Behavioral: runs a small
subprocess and asks for the events.emit capability.

entries.name: Header Clock
entries.description: A wall-clock in the header, updated once a second.
entries.preview:
# Header Clock

Adds the current time to the header. Declarative: mounts a
single text node and ships its own dim token, no subprocess.
